'''Nimbuzzy''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Fluffle]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Galewether]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current description: "To avoid looking like a weather forecast app icon, Nimbuzzy tries to act as imposing and serious as possible. Unfortunately, a loud thunderous rumble would come out of nowhere whenever Nimbuzzy gets flustered, and that's just even more embarrassing."

Nimbuzzy is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A sheep that hovers in the air above a lightning bolt. It has white wool that resembles clouds covering its body and the top of its head. It also has orange hooves and curved, ram-like horns. Its skin is a deep blue, and it has orange irises with yellow, slit pupils. Its ears are floppy and it has a stubby little tail.

Nimbuzzy's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces blue with purple.

== Evolution Trial ==
Nimbuzzy's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into Galewether you need to complete the following two tasks:
* Feed Nimbuzzy to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Treasure Hunt]] (dig up 70 treasure) or [[Cozy Farm]] (use x4200 fertilizer).

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Thor had goats called Tanngrisnir and Tanngnjóstr to pull his sky chariot. Nimbuzzy is their young sister."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Adjusts body size to changes in the air pressure, and is capable of conjuring small storms. Rain often follows in Nimbuzzy's presence."
